name: NanoFlow Reel
_note: Brand Kit reel template (Hook A, Named Pain Moment). Vertical cut only. Every file in media/ is a labelled PLACEHOLDER: replace each with a real capture from the NanoFlow demo tenant (no real customer data) before rendering for use.

mascot.description: a glossy 3D cartoon robot mascot with a purple domed helmet and an orange-tipped antenna, a black face visor with glowing curved happy eyes, round orange ear pieces, a white body with a magenta-to-orange chest stripe, purple hands and orange feet

poses.wave: waving hello with one hand raised, mid-step, cheerful
poses.phone: proudly holding up a modern smartphone in both hands, screen facing the viewer showing a simple play-button video thumbnail, excited; no words on the screen
poses.clipboard: holding a clipboard with three big green check marks on it, pointing at the top item with the other hand, confident; no writing on the clipboard
poses.relax: relaxed and content, leaning back with one hand behind its head and holding a white coffee mug in the other, legs casually crossed while standing
poses.ladder: standing on a small grey stepladder holding a wrench in one hand, turning in surprise toward a smartphone it holds out in the other hand, eyes shaped as wide surprised circles; full body including the ladder
poses.tired: exhausted, sitting slumped on a small stool, shoulders down, head drooping, holding an open laptop on its knees, eyes as tired flat half-closed lines; nothing on the laptop screen
poses.headset: wearing a slim black call-centre headset with a small microphone, one hand touching the earpiece, the other giving a thumbs up, friendly and attentive
poses.mail: cheerfully sorting mail, holding a neat stack of white envelopes in one arm and tossing one envelope with the other hand; no writing on the envelopes
poses.star: proudly holding a big glossy golden five-point star above its head with both hands, joyful
poses.point: standing side-on, pointing confidently to the right with one arm fully extended, as if presenting something, other hand on hip
poses.chat: holding up a big white rounded chat speech bubble with three dots in it, friendly, slightly tilted head
poses.jump: jumping happily mid-air with both arms raised in celebration, legs tucked

bed_a.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Light tech-commercial underscore, 108 bpm, plucky marimba and muted synth bass, starts bouncy for four seconds then becomes slightly hurried and tense with a ticking hi-hat and minor colour, sparse so a voiceover sits on top, ends on an unresolved suspended note.

bed_b.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Bright upbeat friendly product launch music, 112 bpm, warm major key, claps, plucky synths, light piano, punchy kick, optimistic and confident, steady energy that stays under a voiceover, builds gently, ends on a clean resolved final chord with a short tail.
